journal_lines: §aHeat off the ground before I reached the canopy. §oSmelled like soil and rot and something flowering.§o Good §lJungle§l timber inside the vines.
§aCut through three vines before I reached the trunk. The trunk did not fall cleanly.
§aSomething moved in the understory. Held still. It moved on. Back to work.
§aThe air here is wet enough to drink. §oSweat and rain and bark all the same smell.§o Took longer because of it.
§aOrchids growing from a wound in the bark. Left the wound. Took the timber nearby.
§aVines came down with the tree. §lJungle§l doesn't let go of anything without argument.
§aDense wood, heavy timber. §oSmells green all the way through, even at the cut.§o Good take.
§aA bird watched from three canopy levels up. Did not move when the tree went. Unimpressed.
§aFallen trunk already claimed by ferns and beetles. Found a standing one further in.
§aTook twice as long as a forest would have. §lJungle§l gives timber slowly.
